claims.value: PC-9_afatinib_<time>_R<n> (heavy) and PC-9_DMSO_in_mix_<time>_R<n> (light); 24 sources, 5 fraction files each
claims.evidence: experimentalDesignTemplate.txt assigns the 60 SILAC raws to 12 experiments 24h-R1..7D-R3 (5 high-pH fractions each, fr1..fr5; fr3_p2 is the only fr3 file of 5D-R2, 7D-R2, 7D-R3). Each experiment is one SILAC mixture; each source = one channel of one mixture. Light source names do not assert a time-matched DMSO culture (only that it is the DMSO channel of that mixture).

claims.value: SILAC heavy = afatinib-treated PC-9; SILAC light = DMSO control (untreated)
claims.evidence: Design: thesis Supp Fig S2A legend "PC9 cells were treated with 10nM Afatinib for 1, 3, 5 or 7 days for full proteome analysis. PCA showed separation of ratios of time points versus DMSO" -> each mixture = afatinib time point vs DMSO. Paper/PRIDE: only the heavy label (Arg6/Lys4) is described; MaxQuant Multiplicity 2, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, ratio H/L. Orientation (no explicit heavy=treated sentence exists; see limitations): the paper reports CAPN2 decreased and ATP2C1, MARCKS, MARCKSL1, CNN2 increased after afatinib (Fig 4B text); deposited log2 H/L 3D/5D/7D: CAPN2 -0.22..-0.36 at 3D/5D, ATP2C1 +0.30..+1.01, MARCKS +0.32..+0.61, MARCKSL1 +0.88..+1.14, CNN2 +0.43..+1.23; cell-cycle drug signature (EGFR inhibition) MKI67 -0.73..-1.36, MCM2/3/7, PCNA, CCNB1 all negative at 3D-7D. All 12 experiments correlate positively (Pearson 0.16-0.80), i.e. no label swap; 24h has weaker effects but correlates +0.35..+0.39 with 3D. Hence heavy = afatinib in all 12 mixtures. Controls written untreated (campaign rule 4); the vehicle was DMSO.

limitations: Channel orientation (heavy = afatinib, light = DMSO) has no explicit sentence in the paper, PRIDE protocol or thesis; the AACR Supplementary Materials and Methods / Tables S1 (proteome ratios) are behind a Cloudflare bot check at aacrjournals.org (HTTP 403, not bypassed). The map rests on (a) the explicit design "ratios of time points versus DMSO" (thesis Supp Fig S2A), (b) only the heavy label being described, and (c) the deposited H/L direction of 5 proteins the paper names plus the EGFR-inhibition cell-cycle signature, consistent in all 12 mixtures (orientation.txt, correlation.txt). It is a data-checked inference, not a stated label sheet.

Whether the 12 DMSO (light) channels are 12 independent, time-matched cultures or aliquots of fewer DMSO cultures is not documented; light rows carry sampling time not available and biological replicate 1-12 (one per mixture).

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.5.6.0 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record precursor tolerances and no mqpar.xml was deposited. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ("Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available"), as for campaign precedents PXD014368/PXD006676/PXD024103.
Cleavage agent: PRIDE says Trypsin/LysC for the full proteome while the paper mentions only trypsin; PRIDE was followed (explicitly about the full proteome).
Culture medium of the light (DMSO) cultures not stated (labeling medium DMEM described for heavy only; regular growth medium RPMI 1640).

Out of scope (not SILAC, LFQ per PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol "Kinobead data and phospho data was quantified using LFQ"): 15 kinobead raws (OR13_A2_20161011_TCM_exp15_KBPD_PC9_Afat_*) and 24 Fe-IMAC phosphoproteome raws (*_TCM_PC9_Af_IMAC_*); plus the SEARCH/PEAK zips (search output and peak lists).
